reasons: Couldn't confirm this is the same padlock. Both are dark rusted iron padlocks, but not the same physical object. Photo A has a wide, layered body with a stepped ornate side profile, a central vertical plate, and three clearly visible circular holes/notches, plus a round rivet at the right shackle base. Photo B has a narrow plain solid block body with straight edges, no layering, no holes, and no rivet, with the shackle legs almost flush to the body edges. The body-width to shackle-width ratio and body construction differ and cannot be explained by front/back view, light or compression.
